meta_runtime.rerank_reason: The hosted Vercel bundle does not install the optional PyTorch cross-encoder (size and cold start). Retrieval is hybrid NumPy cosine + BM25 with reciprocal-rank fusion and the same five-passage context.
meta_runtime.evaluation_note: Historical local evaluations do not measure this hosted profile's retrieval accuracy. Separate hosted visitor diagnostics are recorded in the project report; their AI assessments are not human verification.

budget.note: Ledger lives in /tmp on each Vercel instance; it resets when the instance is recycled and is not shared across concurrently running instances. It is not a global spending limit. Use deployment protection and provider rate/quota controls to manage exposure; Azure budget alerts alone do not enforce a hard cap.

meta_runtime.request_serialization: one answer at a time per instance; instances do not coordinate
